plan.description: 找出医生工号为 `'S001'` 的医生接诊/治疗过的患者编号。
最终：我的血糖结果
plan.sql: SELECT test_name, result_value, unit FROM clinical_records WHERE patient_id = '{subject_id}' AND record_type = 'lab' AND test_name = '血糖'

plan.description: 筛选出门诊就诊记录。
按科室统计门诊量。
plan.sql:
SELECT department, COUNT(visit_id) AS outpatient_count
FROM visits
WHERE visit_type = '门诊'
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department ASC;

plan.description: 中间：关联临床记录与费用（跨域个人级 JOIN）
plan.sql: SELECT c.patient_id, c.diagnosis_name, b.amount FROM clinical_records c JOIN billing b ON c.visit_id = b.visit_id WHERE c.record_type = 'diagnosis'

plan.description: 最终：按诊断汇总费用
plan.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM billing

plan.description: 最终：我的用药说明
plan.sql: SELECT drug_name, dosage, frequency, route FROM clinical_records WHERE patient_id = '{subject_id}' AND record_type = 'medication'

plan.description: 查询科室为“心内科”的医生姓名。

Identify the disease name referred to by “这个病” from the conversation context.  
Sub question 2: Count how many distinct patients treated by doctor S001 have this disease.
plan.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.patient_id)
FROM clinical_records AS T1
INNER JOIN visits AS T2
  ON T1.patient_id = T2.patient_id
WHERE T2.doctor_id = 'S001'
  AND T1.diagnosis_name = '疾病名称';

plan.description: 查询患者 P001 的血糖检测结果。
plan.sql:
SELECT `result_value`, `unit`
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `patient_id` = 'P001'
  AND `test_name` = '血糖';

plan.description: 查询患者 P001 的血糖检验记录。
plan.sql:
SELECT T1.`test_name`, T1.`result_value`, T1.`unit`, T1.`ref_range`
FROM `clinical_records` AS T1
WHERE T1.`patient_id` = 'P001'
  AND T1.`record_type` = 'lab'
  AND T1.`test_name` LIKE '%血糖%';

plan.description: 获取患者 P001 最近一次血糖检验的结果，用于判断血糖是否偏高。
plan.sql:
SELECT T1.`test_name`, T1.`result_value`, T1.`unit`, T1.`ref_range`
FROM `clinical_records` AS T1
INNER JOIN `visits` AS T2
  ON T1.`visit_id` = T2.`visit_id`
WHERE T1.`patient_id` = 'P001'
  AND T1.`record_type` = 'lab'
  AND T1.`test_name` LIKE '%血糖%'
ORDER BY T2.`visit_date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

plan.description: 获取患者 P001 的诊断记录及病情程度。
plan.sql:
SELECT `diagnosis_name`, `severity`
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `patient_id` = 'P001'
  AND `record_type` = 'diagnosis';

plan.description: 将病情程度映射为风险等级，判断风险是否高。
plan.sql:
SELECT `diagnosis_name`,
       CASE
           WHEN `severity` = '重' THEN '高风险'
           WHEN `severity` = '中' THEN '中风险'
           WHEN `severity` = '轻' THEN '低风险'
           ELSE '未知'
       END AS `risk_level`
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `patient_id` = 'P001'
  AND `record_type` = 'diagnosis';

plan.description: 获取患者 P001 的临床记录中的病情程度（severity）。
根据最高病情程度判断风险等级（重=高风险，中=中风险，轻=低风险）。
plan.sql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN severity = '重' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '高风险'
         WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN severity = '中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '中风险'
         WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN severity = '轻' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN '低风险'
         ELSE '未知'
       END AS risk_assessment
  FROM clinical_records
  WHERE patient_id = 'P001';

plan.description: Find whether patient P001 has any emergency visits.
plan.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM visits 
WHERE patient_id = 'P001' 
  AND visit_type = '急诊';

plan.description: Based on the existence of emergency visits, determine if the illness is urgent.
plan.sql:
SELECT CASE 
         WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 
           FROM visits 
           WHERE patient_id = 'P001' 
             AND visit_type = '急诊'
         ) 
         THEN '是' 
         ELSE '否' 
       END AS is_urgent;

plan.description: Find all medication records for patient P001.
plan.sql:
SELECT record_id, drug_name, dosage
FROM clinical_records
WHERE patient_id = 'P001'
  AND record_type = 'medication';

plan.description: Get the dosage per administration for each medication belonging to patient P001.
plan.sql:
SELECT drug_name, dosage
FROM clinical_records
WHERE patient_id = 'P001'
  AND record_type = 'medication'
  AND dosage IS NOT NULL;

plan.description: Count the total number of patients in the hospital.
plan.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patients;

plan.description: 找出所有诊断记录中的疾病名称和病人编号。
plan.sql:
SELECT `diagnosis_name`, `patient_id`
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `record_type` = 'diagnosis'
  AND `diagnosis_name` IS NOT NULL;

plan.description: 按疾病分组，统计每种病对应的不同病人数量。
plan.sql:
SELECT `diagnosis_name`, COUNT(DISTINCT `patient_id`) AS patient_count
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `record_type` = 'diagnosis'
  AND `diagnosis_name` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `diagnosis_name`;

plan.description: 找出病人数量最多的疾病名称。
plan.sql:
SELECT `diagnosis_name`
FROM `clinical_records`
WHERE `record_type` = 'diagnosis'
  AND `diagnosis_name` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY `diagnosis_name`
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT `patient_id`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

plan.description: 获取今天由医生 S001 接诊的就诊记录。
plan.sql:
SELECT patient_id
FROM visits
WHERE doctor_id = 'S001'
  AND visit_date = DATE('now');

plan.description: 统计这些就诊记录中去重后的患者数量。
plan.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id)
FROM visits
WHERE doctor_id = 'S001'
  AND visit_date = DATE('now');

plan.description: Find all patients received by doctor `S001`.
plan.sql:
SELECT patient_id
FROM visits
WHERE doctor_id = 'S001'

plan.description: Count how many distinct patients doctor `S001` received.
plan.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id)
FROM visits
WHERE doctor_id = 'S001'
